verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS that stores scanned mail in its cloud, so choosing a data region is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows that users can pick a physical mail-center location ('Choose from 2500+ locations') and that scans go to 'Free Unlimited Online Storage' and a 'secure cloud'. Nothing documents choosing the region or residency of the stored digital data. Picking where physical mail arrives is an adjacent feature, not data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
